structured.answer: After 8 years, putting in 500 ₪ a month, it shows about 68,853 ₪ "נשאר בידיים" on 48,000 ₪ I put in myself. For 4 years it gives me no number at all, because for self-employed people it only says "לעצמאים עוד אין כאן חישוב למשיכה לפני 6 שנים".

stuck.why: I tapped "8" and it went to 7. I had to tap the 8 column a second time.

The only number on screen was 25,725, and at first I thought that was my answer. It's actually the "אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך" column, not the fund. The fund's bar was just an empty dashed box with an orange note next to it.

used: The orange note about withdrawing before 6 years
The column numbers 48,000 / +9,581 / 0 / 68,853 / 55,471 and their labels
skimmed: The opening paragraph under "מה זה" (I only took from it that you can withdraw after 6 years)
The text under the chart about 7% and 2% inflation
skipped: The paragraph about the comparison fund
The "שווה לדעת" and "מי מציע ומי מצטרף" tabs
unsure_meaning: The 55,471 in the "אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך" column: is it after tax? Is it a real option for me?
Whether 68,853 is in today's money or not (it said something about prices, but I didn't really read it)
not_found: Any number for withdrawing after 4 years as a self-employed person, even a rough one with tax

findings.what: For self-employed people there's no calculation before 6 years. The 4-year bar is an empty box, so the only number you see is the comparison one (25,725), and it's easy to take that as the fund's number
findings.where: Chart and number area under the slider, years 1–5
The year numbers under the chart

findings.what: The "נשאר בידיים" number at 8 years isn't printed in the list under the columns where you'd expect it. It's only written above the column, and the white column gets lost next to the others
"הכנסה חייבת בחודש" isn't clear. Do I need to change it? Does it affect anything?
